description: Deletes one question a participant asked, together with its thread, so it disappears from the live console for good. Take it when someone posted something you do not want to keep, for example a link to a competing offer. A host would say: "Please remove the question with the spam link before the next session." It needs the session, the webinar and the question id from your question list, plus a clear yes from you before anything is removed. The question cannot be brought back, and nobody is emailed about it. To clear a whole set at once there is a separate tool. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: delete question, remove question, spam question, clean up questions, participant question

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that this question may be deleted.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_delete_webinar_question
title: Delete one participant question
